title: Stage a high mastery bar
statement: Bring in a high mastery bar in stages, advisory at first and blocking later, because a flat high bar from the start can leave most learners no way in.
example: Only about 17% of one cohort cleared a 90% bar.
detail: Under the existing course's design only about 17% of students cleared a 90% mastery bar (`grade3-reading/artifacts/wiki-research/cross-cutting.md`). The approved plan for a new course therefore makes the first band's gates advisory and starts blocking 90% gates in the second band, because a flat wall at the start has no path for the other 83% (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/approval_clean.md`).
against: The staging answers the 17% figure; nothing here measured whether a staged bar lets more students through. The sources give that measured share as the reason; none of them reports staged gates raising learning.
